transitions.name: unchanged-recheck
transitions.expect: same raw occurrence with current reviewed disposition

transitions.name: new-copy
transitions.expect: new independently actionable occurrence; original remains reviewed

transitions.name: dependency-edit
transitions.expect: original acceptance stale with watched_file_changed reason

transitions.name: owner-edit
transitions.expect: whole-file evidence invalidates the original acceptance

transitions.name: missing-occurrence
transitions.expect: history remains inspectable; absence is not automatically a fix

identifiers: Use IDs, hashes and record digests returned by the tested binary; none are precomputed here.
